# Feedback report: what separates meetings from rejections

_Independent project by Moritz Hanbuch._

**SYNTHETIC DEMO.** The outcomes below were generated by a formula that rewards pain and signal scores (`config/status/demo_accounts_status.csv`). They show what the report looks like. They are not real outreach results, and the separation you see is the formula coming back out.

Outcomes: 40 (19 meeting or won, 21 lost or not a fit). Source: SYNTHETIC demo outcomes.

Method: per score component, the mean in each group, Cohen's d and AUC with a bootstrap 90% interval. AUC 0.5 means the component does not separate the groups; an interval that includes 0.5 means you cannot tell yet. Nothing is refitted automatically.

| Component | Mean, meetings | Mean, rejections | Cohen's d | AUC | 90% interval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pain_score | 67.9 | 57.1 | 1.14 | 0.8 | 0.67 to 0.91 |
| pain:days | 36.5 | 30.1 | 0.72 | 0.68 | 0.54 to 0.81 |
| fit_score | 79.1 | 83.0 | -0.51 | 0.37 | 0.22 to 0.52 |
| pain:pct_over_60 | 14.4 | 12.8 | 0.65 | 0.63 | 0.51 to 0.74 |
| signal_score | 41.7 | 35.8 | 0.46 | 0.62 | 0.48 to 0.75 |
| priority_score | 69.0 | 65.5 | 0.59 | 0.62 | 0.46 to 0.78 |
| fit:supplier_breadth | 3.2 | 3.6 | -0.37 | 0.38 | 0.24 to 0.51 |
| fit:geography | 22.0 | 22.6 | -0.37 | 0.41 | 0.29 to 0.54 |
| pain:trend | 5.7 | 3.9 | 0.33 | 0.58 | 0.44 to 0.73 |
| fit:revenue | 21.7 | 23.1 | -0.25 | 0.43 | 0.28 to 0.58 |
| pain:pct_late | 15.0 | 13.2 | 0.2 | 0.55 | 0.4 to 0.71 |
| fit:sector | 27.2 | 28.6 | -0.42 | 0.51 | 0.36 to 0.65 |

Components whose interval excludes 0.5: pain_score, pain:days, pain:pct_over_60.

What to do with it: raise the weight of a component that clearly separates, question one that points the wrong way (AUC below 0.5), and read the rejection reasons before touching any weight. With a few dozen outcomes this is a prompt for judgement, not a model.
